item.clowderhall.hub_key.desc: Brass still cold. Toggle Clowder Hall — enter or return.
message.clowderhall.hub_already: You are already in Clowder Hall.
message.clowderhall.hub_missing: Clowder Hall dimension is not loaded.
message.clowderhall.hub_return_spawn: No saved exit — Clowder Dock spawn.
message.clowderhall.hub_return_not_in_ha: You are not in Clowder Hall — use /clowder hub first, then /clowder return.
message.clowderhall.hub_in_arena: The Hub Key will not pull you out of an arena. Finish the fight or /guardians leave.
message.clowderhall.revive_self: Rare life rewards restore the shared pool. An operator can use /skybound revive [player].
message.clowderhall.revive_self_not_spec: Self-revive only works while you are a soft-hardcore spectator.
message.clowderhall.revive_not_mate: That player is not on your Skyblock / FTB Clowder team.
message.clowderhall.revive_not_spectator: That Clowder mate is not out of lives (spectator).
message.clowderhall.revive_disabled: Soft hardcore lives are disabled in config.
command.clowderhall.help.hub: /clowder hub — teleport to Clowder Hall (hub dimension)
command.clowderhall.help.return: /clowder return — leave Hall to your last pad (must be in Hall)
command.clowderhall.help.revive: /skybound lives — shared pool; rare late quests grant +1. Revive commands require an operator.
command.clowderhall.help.resetisland: /clowder resetisland — admin pointer to /skyblock island tools
command.clowderhall.help.charter: Island Charter or K: Clowder panel. Sneak-use Charter on your pad: seal spawn. Hub Key: enter or leave the Hall.
command.clowderhall.reset.header: No pad was deleted. Use Skyblock Builder to rebuild or reassign islands:
command.clowderhall.reset.travel: /skyblock spawn | /skyblock visit — Dock and pad travel
command.clowderhall.reset.ops: Ops: /skyblock manage — regenerate or clear a team island when needed
command.clowderhall.help.invite: /clowder invite <player> — invite them to your Clowder (they run /clowder accept)
message.clowderhall.invite_no_skyblock: Clowder teams need Skyblock Builder installed.
message.clowderhall.invite_received: %s invites you to their Clowder — click here, or run /clowder accept.
message.clowderhall.invite_no_team: Make a Clowder first: open the panel (K) and Create Team, then invite.
message.clowderhall.invite_target_has_te: That player is already on a Clowder.
message.clowderhall.accept_ok: You joined the Clowder — same pad, quests and shared lives now.
message.clowderhall.accept_none: You have no pending Clowder invite.
message.clowderhall.accept_has_team: You are already on a Clowder.
message.clowderhall.invite_already: %s already has an invite from your Clowder — they can click it or run /clowder accept.
